provenance: Fictional negative boundary fixtures for Followthrough A2/A6 verification. DO NOT seed into app/data/synthetic.json; each case must be rejected or blocked.

startup_rejection_cases.description: Duplicate organisation ID in orgs collection must fail startup validation and log data_rejected.
startup_rejection_cases.mutation_from_baseline: Append a second org entry with id 'org-1'.
startup_rejection_cases.expected_error_substring: Invalid dataset: missing or duplicate orgs ID

startup_rejection_cases.description: Order referencing a non-existent lot ID ('lot-999') or org ID ('org-999') must fail startup validation.
Person email outside @example.test must be rejected at startup to prevent accidental live addressing.
Person with a WhatsApp number not listed in WHATSAPP_TEST_NUMBERS must fail startup validation.
startup_rejection_cases.mutation_from_baseline: Set person-5 whatsapp to '+447700900899' while WHATSAPP_TEST_NUMBERS excludes it.

startup_rejection_cases.description: Lot with left_kg > start_kg (or negative left_kg, or start_kg <= 0) must fail startup validation.
startup_rejection_cases.mutation_from_baseline: Set lot-1 left_kg to 75 while start_kg is 60.

startup_rejection_cases.description: Non-existent calendar date ('2026-02-30') or duplicate stall date must fail startup validation.

runtime_recipient_boundary_cases.description: With APP_LIVE=false, outbound email addressed to a counterpart is rewritten exclusively to OWNER_TEST_EMAILS.
Outbound WhatsApp send to any E.164 number absent from WHATSAPP_TEST_NUMBERS is refused before provider call.
runtime_recipient_boundary_cases.expected_error_substring: WhatsApp recipient is not on verified test list

runtime_recipient_boundary_cases.description: Inbound WhatsApp webhook from a non-allowlisted number is discarded before content persistence and logged as blocked.
